text: Some airspace adjacent to Hong Kong flight information region requires the use of both standard feet and metric meters units. To avoid any confusion with level information, the following standard phraseology shall be applied. Number one, when referring to an altitude, the unit shall always be specified. For example, descend to 6,000 feet or meters. When referring to flight level, only the metric unit shall be specified. For example, climb to flight level 150 or climb to flight level 8,400 meters. Question. Which of the following instructions is correct?
